outline: 讓學生對於模糊邏輯、模糊推論有一整體性了解，並對於將模糊邏輯在控制工程之應用具有理論與軟體撰寫之能力。
schedule:
1.	The mathematics of fuzzy systems and control
	Fuzzy sets and basic operations on fuzzy sets
	Fuzzy relations and the Extension Principle
	Linguistic Variables and Fuzzy IF-THEN rules
2.	Fuzzy systems and their properties
	Fuzzy rule base and fuzzy inference engine
	Fuzzifiers and defuzzifiers
	Fuzzy systems as nonlinear mappings
	Approximation properties of fuzzy systems
3.	Design of fuzzy systems from input/output data
	Design of fuzzy systems using a table look-up scheme
	Design of fuzzy systems using gradient descent training
	Design of fuzzy systems using Recursive Least Squares
4.	Fuzzy Control
	The trial-and-error approach to fuzzy controller design
	Fuzzy control of linear system: stable controllers
	Fuzzy control of nonlinear systems I: Sliding control
	Fuzzy control of nonlinear systems II: supervisory control
	Fuzzy control of fuzzy system models
	Qualitative Analysis of fuzzy control systems
assessment:
1st, 2nd, 3rd exam.: 20% each.
take home exam.: 20%
homework: 20%
